title: One follow button on shared profiles
summary: Follow someone from a single pill under their name. Once you follow them it reads Following, with a menu showing since when and an Unfollow option.
changes: Shared profiles have one Follow button under the name. After you follow, it switches to Following with a dropdown arrow; the dropdown shows Since <month year> and Unfollow.
Friends-only profiles show Request to follow, then Requested with a dropdown to cancel the request.
Shared profiles no longer show whether someone is Public, Friends only or Private.
Follows you now sits beside the Joined date.

image.alt: Shared profile header with Joined October 2026 and a Follows you chip, and the Following pill open to a menu showing Since Oct 2026 and Unfollow.
